description.shortText: In-store robots are being used to test human-robot interactions. By simply responding to inquiries in several languages, robots can help both tourists and customers locate what they're looking for. Such automated customer service representatives can save up countless hours for human representatives, enabling on-demand assistance. This assistance agent is versatile and adaptive to any environment (i.e., useful for retail, events, airports, and any other large settings).
